tagline: Write CSS. The frogs hop. Close it, come back still on the same pad — or invite a friend into this pond.
description:
Close it on level 12, open it tomorrow — still on 12, still with the CSS you left. No account. Works on a plane.

Send the Invite in the bar above and a friend lands in this pond with you. You share the CSS: whoever types, the frogs hop on both screens.

On your own it is Flexbox Froggy. Twenty-four levels, from justify-content to align-content. Click a property name to see the values. A harder setting hides the directions; colorblind mode draws shapes on the frogs.

An unofficial port of Flexbox Froggy by Thomas Park. The frogs, the pads and the puzzles are his.
